models_evaluated: Automated deep learning DR screening software (ADLS)
unlisted_practices: Comparing agreement between human graders of varying expertise and an automated deep learning DR grading tool for referral decisions

screen.reason: The study evaluates an automated deep learning diabetic retinopathy screening software compared to human graders of varying expertise on a retrospective dataset of 200 fundus photographs. It tests diagnostic performance and agreement rather than a specific deployment guardrail or implementation practice.
